LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 13 November 2026

This site (jayraidxyz) is a personal developer portfolio and learning library. This policy explains what personal data it handles, why, and your choices. I keep data collection to the minimum needed to run the site.

What I collect

Google sign-in (Resources page). To open the Resources page you sign in with Google. I receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google. I do not receive your Google password, contacts, Drive files or any other Google data.

Free notes sign-up. If you request the free PDF, I collect the email address you enter.

Technical data. My hosting provider (Vercel) may process standard request data such as IP address, browser type and pages requested, for security and operation of the service.

How I use it

  • To confirm you are signed in and keep the Resources page available to signed-in visitors
  • To restrict access to approved accounts, where an allow-list is enabled
  • To send you the free notes and, if you opted in, occasional updates about new content
  • To keep the site secure and working

I do not sell your data, and I do not use it for advertising or profiling.

Cookies and sessions

Signing in sets a secure, encrypted session cookie (and short-lived cookies used during the Google login flow). These are strictly necessary for authentication. Your session data is stored in the cookie itself, not in a database on my side. This site does not use advertising or third-party analytics cookies.

Who I share data with

  • Google: to authenticate you. Their handling of your data is covered by Google's Privacy Policy.
  • Vercel: hosting and infrastructure.
  • My email provider or automation tool: receives the email address you submit for the free notes, so I can deliver and send updates.

I may disclose data if required by law.

Google API data

The site's use of information received from Google is limited to authenticating you and displaying your email on the Resources page. It is not used for advertising, not transferred to third parties except as needed to provide the service, and not used to train AI models.

Retention

Session cookies expire automatically or when you sign out. Email addresses submitted for the free notes are kept until you unsubscribe or ask me to delete them. Hosting logs are kept by Vercel under its own retention rules.

Your rights and choices

You can sign out at any time, unsubscribe from any email, and ask me to access, correct or delete your data. You can also revoke this site's access from your Google Account under Security, then Third-party apps with account access. Depending on where you live (including Nigeria under the NDPA, and the UK/EU under GDPR), you may have additional legal rights. Contact me and I will respond promptly.

Children

This site is not directed at children under 13, and I do not knowingly collect their data.

Changes

If I change this policy, I will update the date above. Material changes will be flagged on this page.

Contact

Questions or requests: hello@example.com

Educational content only. Nothing on this site is financial advice.
